subject: alt-c-pg
title: ALT.C.PG.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 478 (TRF(II)-14). ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) is the subject; SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: WO-UNF (world unification), TR-INFO (trans-information) and EXP-CONT-1 (expansion condition (composite focus)). From WO-UNF: ECO-DYM (economic dynamics). From ECO-DYM: INT (intention). From TR-INFO: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation). From MT-INTR: INFO-SOLD (information solidification). From INFO-SOLD: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From EXP-CONT-1: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From EXT-FT: RES-RT (responsibility ratio) and SCI-DY (scientific dynamics).
